items.description: Close and repaint the disturbed wall area
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.2 and 7.1.7(a) cover making good the wall opened to reach the leaking pipe. Allow €310 gross for patching and repainting the local area only, consistent with §7.1.5.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge on the building-services invoice. Allow €41 gross for one call-out.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers consumable sealing material used in the pipe repair. Allow €8 gross for the single charge.
Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) cover the replacement section of the failed internal supply pipe. Allow €24 gross for one metre at the pre-loss standard under §7.1.9.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstating insulation that formed part of the repaired installation. Allow €14 gross for one metre of equivalent insulation.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary trade labour at customary rates. Allow one installer hour at €96 gross.

Section 7.1.8(b) excludes a separate charge for the contractor's own measuring device, even though necessary investigation is covered under §7.1.7(e). If documented as eligible third-party hire rather than owned equipment, allow €18 gross.

Section 7.1.7(g) limits labour to the time reasonably needed; the localized opening, investigation and drying setup do not substantiate all nine hours. Allow approximately four hours at €95 gross per hour, separate from the installer hour and the painter's reinstatement.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows only the first travel charge by this contractor on this invoice, even for separate visits. The conditional benchmark is €41 gross for one eligible trip.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying and one equipment deployment charge per drying operation. Allow €145 gross for brief deployment to dry the local wall area.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes contractor blades as business equipment, rather than material installed in the repair. The conditional benchmark for one blade is €12 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers ordinary fittings used to connect the repaired pipe section. Allow two fittings at €18 gross each, provided they correspond to the repair under §7.1.8(d).
Sections 7.1.8(c) and (d) bar duplicate material charges and quantities not supported by the repair record. Only if a distinct second metre is documented would another €24 gross be reasonable.
Sections 7.1.8(c) and (d) exclude a second insulation charge unless it is shown to serve a distinct repaired section rather than the metre already billed. If separately justified, allow €14 gross.

Section 7.1.8(c) excludes duplicate labour, and a return visit alone does not substantiate a second identical nine-hour entry under §7.1.7(g). If separate necessary follow-up labour is documented, allow one hour at €95 gross.
